adaptive_development_addition.reason: The initial short-protein pilot showed changed early sampling but no new primary dual-mode hits at epsilon 0.05; test whether a stronger early penalty can reach an alternate mode.
adaptive_development_addition.timing: Added after inspecting partial development results and before inspecting or scoring any held-out test reference.
adaptive_development_addition.interpretation: Exploratory development tuning; compare on the held-out primary test, not as a confirmatory pilot result.

candidate_score: two-token joint log probability - effective_epsilon * prior completed-rollout count
annealing: effective_epsilon = initial_epsilon * max(0, 1 - emitted_contacts / decay_contacts); decay_contacts=0 means constant
selection_rule: Prefer primary-development blind dual-mode coverage, then seven-pair oracle dual-mode coverage and minority enrichment, then lower H100 cost; freeze before primary held-out scoring
scoring: exp304 contact-level 25% recall and 0.10 enrichment; blind 16-map shortlist sealed before reference reveal
reference_policy: No references in decoder; only development references may choose a configuration; eval-test unread
